card.name: Just before the word women or girls
card.fires_on: The word just before a female group noun such as women, woman or girls, often a modifier or small linking word. Seen in estrogen and menstruation text, e.g. after hysterectomized, postmenopausal or non-smoking.

modes.label: Modifier before women
modes.description: Part of a descriptive term that directly precedes women.
modes.example: a population of 2,947 hysterectom<<ized>> women 65 to 79

modes.label: Linking word before girls or woman
modes.description: A small word like in or a that leads into girl, girls or woman.
modes.example: Menstruation (a period) is a major stage of puberty<< in>> girls; it's one of the many

card.writes: It boosts male and female terms such as girls and women, and lowers generic words like child and people.
card.plain: It fires when the next word is likely to be women or girls.
